documents.retainedBytesUtf8: Managed settings are the settings your organization deploys to every developer's machine. Claude Code applies them above every other level, so no user, project, local, or `--settings` value overrides them, apart from a few [security-sensitive exceptions](/docs/en/settings#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence) where a stricter value from a lower level still counts.
